title: Teesta matters to us: A people’s march to save the waters
description: ‘Aachulay!’ (Life, its whole cycle in this world, and beyond, where lie the ancestors) is an interjection of praise in Róng, the Lepcha language. People shout it out on occasions of births and weddings, and even to symbolise protest.  On July 26, 2026, when I met the marching group near Tarkhola, I was greeted with a sonorous ‘Aachulay!’ This time it meant resistance and dissent.
